title: Nuevas ciudades
goal: Read how Buenos Aires and Mexico City transformed from colonial-looking towns into Paris-inspired capitals in a couple of decades -- and who that modernization actually reached.
grammar: Imperfecto: describir cómo era la ciudad antes

items: Describe what Buenos Aires was like before the 1880s.
Explain what drove the city's rapid transformation starting in 1880.
Name the avenue that symbolized Mexico City's modernization under Porfirio Díaz.
Compare both cities' colonial appearance before and European appearance after.
Use the imperfect to describe a standing scene before a preterite marks the change.
